brief_rationale: The doctor systematically queried the workspace, discovered the high-risk transition context and IV vs oral medication distinctions, repeatedly corrected the family's misconception that IV orders or old home drugs could be self-administered, and obtained explicit caregiver teach-back on red flags, medication non-self-change rules, and verification plans. No responsibility-chain error is present; all five dimensions are rated at least good, and two high-order points (HO1 and HO2) were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, satisfying the Strong boundary. A third high-order point (HO4) was partially but not fully completed with all required criteria, preventing Perfect.
